typeProperties.script:
parameters{
	tblOpics_outputfilename as string ()
}

source(output(
		STP_NONSTP as string,
		BUSINESS_GROUP as string,
		{COUNT(*)} as string,
		{'SPLT'} as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false) ~> OpicsplusDB
OpicsplusDB derive(Loaddate = toString(currentTimestamp())) ~> DerivedColumn
DerivedColumn derive({Copy of BUSINESS_GROUP} = BUSINESS_GROUP,
		{Copy of Loaddate} = Loaddate,
		{Copy of STP_NONSTP} = STP_NONSTP,
		{Copy of COUNT(*)} = {COUNT(*)}) ~> DataConversion
DataConversion sink(input(
		LoadDate as string,
		Business_Group as string,
		STP_NonSTP as string,
		Count as string,
		Source as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	saveOrder: 10000,
	mapColumn(
		LoadDate = {Copy of Loaddate},
		Business_Group = BUSINESS_GROUP,
		STP_NonSTP = {Copy of STP_NONSTP},
		Count = {Copy of COUNT(*)},
		Source = {'SPLT'}),
	partitionFileNames:[($tblOpics_outputfilename)],
	partitionBy('hash', 1)) ~> tblOpics
